stories.headline: Physicians for Human Rights - PHR Health Care Under Attack: Drone Strikes Amidst High Levels Of Violence By State Forces In 2025, New Report Finds New report documents 2,546 incidents of violence against or obstruction of health care across 33 countries in 2025, including 790 incidents where hospitals were
stories.summary: Physicians for Human Rights (PHR) has released a report documenting 2,546 incidents of violence against or obstruction of health care across 33 countries in 2025. This includes 790 incidents where hospitals were targeted. The report highlights high levels of violence by state forces, as well as drone strikes. Russian attacks on health facilities and energy infrastructure in Ukraine have also impeded health care. Additionally, Russian warplanes have been accused of committing war crimes by striking medical facilities in Syria. The report underscores the need to protect health care facilities and workers, and to promote the right to health for all. PHR's findings emphasize the severity of the issue and the importance of addressing these violations to ensure access to health care worldwide. The organization advocates for health professionals to advance health, dignity, and justice.

stories.headline: Iran war: Donald Trump asked for tougher terms in proposed peace deal - US media United States President Donald Trump has sought to change several terms of a proposal to end the Middle East war, US media reported, as a finalised deal...
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has sought to change several terms of a proposal to end the Middle East war, according to US media reports. The proposed deal aims to end the conflict involving Iran. Trump has sent the revised terms back to Iran for consideration. The development comes as a finalized deal remains elusive among the parties involved. The US President's request for tougher terms is seen as a significant step in the negotiations. The proposal's details have not been disclosed, but it is reported that Trump's changes are intended to strengthen the agreement. The move is part of ongoing efforts to reach a peace deal, with the US and other parties working to find a resolution to the conflict. A finalized deal has yet to be reached.

stories.headline: As Iran's internet comes online after months After being cut off from the world for more than 12 weeks, Iranians have come back online. Their initial reactions are joy, shock and confusion.
stories.summary: Iran's internet has been restored after a 12-week blackout, with users experiencing a mix of joy, shock, and confusion. The country's National Information Network was also previously disconnected, even internally. After 88 days of near-total blackout, limited connectivity was reestablished, flooding social media and phones with delayed messages and content. The restoration of internet services comes as US and Iranian negotiators have agreed to resume nuclear talks and allow shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, tensions in the region remain high, with Israel launching strikes across Lebanon and Iran targeting a US air base in Kuwait in response to American strikes on an alleged Iranian drone operation. The situation is complex, with multiple geopolitical factors at play.

stories.headline: Major Aukus switch to buy only secondhand subs from US means ‘significant’ cost savings, Marles says Defence minister says ‘cost-effective’ decision to buy only secondhand Virginia nuclear-powered submarines will make training and operations easier
stories.summary: Australia's Defence Minister Richard Marles announced that the country will purchase only secondhand Virginia-class nuclear-powered submarines from the US under the AUKUS agreement. This decision is expected to result in "significant" cost savings. Marles described the move as "cost-effective" and said it will simplify training and operations for the navy. The government has dropped plans to acquire newly built submarines, instead opting for used ones. The change is expected to reduce the purchase price and associated training and operational costs. Marles defended the decision, stating that having a consistent set of secondhand submarines will make operations easier and more efficient. The exact amount of cost savings has not been disclosed, but Marles emphasized that it will be substantial. The decision is part of Australia's efforts to modernize its navy under the AUKUS agreement.

stories.headline: iPhone 18 Pro’s big camera upgrade might cut deeper in your wallet
stories.summary: Apple's next-generation iPhone 18 Pro is expected to feature one of the biggest camera upgrades in years, with a variable-aperture main camera. This upgrade, also coming to the iPhone 18 Pro Max, may significantly increase manufacturing costs. According to analyst reports, the improved camera technology could lead to higher iPhone prices. The camera upgrades include a variable aperture, which will be available on both Pro models. The new iPhones are expected to be released next September, with the camera hardware upgrades being some of the most significant in the lineup's history. The increased manufacturing costs raise questions about whether Apple will pass these costs on to consumers, potentially leading to higher prices for the upcoming iPhone models. The exact price increase is not yet known, but the camera upgrades are expected to revolutionize mobile photography.

stories.headline: Microsoft to add automatic driver rollback to Windows 11
stories.summary: Microsoft is introducing a new feature to Windows 11 called Cloud-Initiated Driver Recovery, which allows for automatic rollback of problematic drivers. This feature is part of the Windows Driver Quality Initiative, announced at WinHEC 2026, aiming to improve driver reliability and prevent issues such as reduced battery life. The rollback process is handled through coordinated updates to the Plug and Play driver stack and driver flighting and publishing services. Currently, users must manually roll back drivers or wait for hardware vendors to publish new ones. The new feature is expected to roll out in September 2026, enhancing Windows Update reliability and protecting PCs from performance issues caused by faulty drivers. This update will simplify the process of resolving driver-related problems, making it easier for users to maintain their system's stability and performance.

stories.headline: Dynamic task offloading for sports training monitoring in MEC-assisted smart wearable device systems
stories.summary: Researchers are investigating dynamic task offloading in Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC)-assisted wearable device systems for sports training monitoring. The goal is to optimize task offloading decisions and CPU frequency to improve system performance. MEC enables smart wearable devices to offload tasks to edge servers, reducing latency and energy consumption. Recent studies have explored various techniques, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning, to enhance task offloading and resource allocation. The OESPO-MEC model, which features computational offloading and resource allocation, has been proposed to address these challenges. By jointly optimizing offloading decisions and resource allocation, the model aims to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of wearable device systems in sports training monitoring applications. This research has the potential to enhance the performance and functionality of wearable devices in various scenarios.

stories.headline: old programming language called COBOL still quietly processes over $3 trillion in banking transactions every single day — and because the original engineers are rapidly retiring, banks are scrambling
stories.summary: COBOL, a 60-year-old programming language, still processes over $3 trillion in banking transactions daily, with estimates suggesting up to 80% of financial transactions rely on it. Despite its age, COBOL remains crucial in the banking and government sectors due to its legacy applications. However, as original engineers retire and fewer new programmers join the workforce, the language's future is uncertain. Several major banks have attempted to migrate off COBOL, but these efforts have been costly and often unsuccessful, with the Commonwealth Bank of Australia spending $750 million over five years. As a result, companies are still seeking COBOL developers to maintain these systems, which have been running for over 40 years and continue to process trillions of dollars daily. The reliance on COBOL highlights the challenges of modernizing legacy applications in critical industries.

stories.headline: Richarlison Trolls Arsenal Following Champions League Final Loss to PSG Paris Saint-Germain won the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League title defeating Arsenal 4–3 in a penalty shootout.
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain won the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League title, defeating Arsenal 4-3 in a penalty shootout. Following the loss, Tottenham player Richarlison trolled Arsenal, taking to social media to mock their defeat. The trolling was met with amusement from some fans, who encouraged the lighthearted teasing. Richarlison's actions came after Arsenal's heartbreaking loss, which marked their first Champions League final appearance in 16 years. The defeat sparked a flurry of reactions, with other players, including Erling Haaland, joining in on the teasing. PSG's victory marked a significant win for the team, securing their title in the 2025-26 season. The Champions League final loss was a disappointing end to Arsenal's impressive run in the tournament.

stories.headline: NBA Finals 2026 Betting Odds Revealed for Wemby, Spurs vs. Jalen Brunson, Knicks Victor Wembanyama is being favored to lead the San Antonio Spurs to a championship over the New York Knicks.
stories.summary: The San Antonio Spurs are favored to win the 2026 NBA Finals against the New York Knicks. The Spurs have odds of -188, while the Knicks have odds of +158. Victor Wembanyama is expected to lead the Spurs to a championship, potentially earning his first title and Finals MVP. The Knicks, led by Jalen Brunson, who averages 26.9 points, will look to upset the favored Spurs. The series marks a rematch of the last time the Knicks made it to the championship. The Spurs are also favored to win Game 1, with the series expected to be a closely watched matchup between Wembanyama and Brunson. The odds suggest a competitive series, with the Spurs' chances of winning the championship slightly higher than the Knicks'.

stories.headline: Should Vaibhav Sooryavanshi Play Test Cricket? Sachin Tendulkar Gives Blunt Verdict Sachin Tendulkar called 15-year-old sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi 'truly special' and said that he would love to see the youngster play Test cricket.
stories.summary: Sachin Tendulkar has endorsed 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to play Test cricket, calling him "truly special". Tendulkar expressed his desire to see Sooryavanshi don the India whites, but warned against rushing him into the format. Sooryavanshi has had a sensational season in the 2026 Indian Premier League, scoring 776 runs in 16 innings at a high strike rate. Tendulkar's comments were made in the presence of BCCI chief selector Ajit Agarkar. The legendary cricketer believes Sooryavanshi has the potential to excel in Test cricket, but emphasizes the need for caution to ensure the young player's development is not hindered by premature exposure to international cricket. Sooryavanshi's impressive performance in the IPL has captivated cricket fans and legends alike, generating excitement about his future prospects.

stories.headline: Top 3 Priorities for Oklahoma City Thunder During 2026 NBA Offseason The era of parity continued on Saturday night, when the San Antonio Spurs won Game 7 and eliminated the defending champion Oklahoma City Thunder.
stories.summary: The San Antonio Spurs won Game 7 against the Oklahoma City Thunder, eliminating the defending champions from the playoffs. The series ended with a win in Oklahoma City, where it had started. Victor Wembanyama led the Spurs, bouncing back from a Game 5 performance where he took only 15 shots and scored 20 points. The Thunder, who had never lost back-to-back playoff games over the last two seasons, were ultimately dethroned. The loss marks the end of the Thunder's title reign, and the team will now focus on the 2026 NBA offseason, where they will need to address key priorities to regain their championship form. The Spurs' win continues the era of parity in the NBA, with no team able to dominate the league.

stories.headline: Who Is Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani? Meet India's New Chief Of Defence Staff General NS Raja Subramani, a senior Army officer with decades of operational and command experience, will succeed General Anil Chauhan.
stories.summary: General NS Raja Subramani has taken charge as India's new Chief of Defence Staff, succeeding General Anil Chauhan who retired on May 30. General Subramani has decades of operational and command experience in the Army. Prior to his appointment, he served as the Military Advisor at the National Security Council Secretariat. He previously held the position of Vice Chief of Army Staff until his retirement on July 31, 2025. General Subramani assumed the role of Chief of Defence Staff on Sunday, becoming the country's senior-most military commander. He brings a wealth of experience and leadership skills to the position, having served in various key roles throughout his military career. General Anil Chauhan's tenure as Chief of Defence Staff came to an end, paving the way for General Subramani's appointment.

stories.headline: 5 killed, 5 under treatment as building collapses near Delhi’s Saket metro; rescue effort on
stories.summary: A five-story building collapsed near the Saket Metro station in South Delhi's Mehrauli area. The incident resulted in the deaths of at least five people, with five others undergoing treatment for their injuries. Rescue efforts are currently underway to search for anyone trapped under the debris. The building, which housed a multi-storey paying guest accommodation and commercial spaces, collapsed on Saturday evening, prompting a major rescue operation. Emergency services are at the scene, working to rescue those trapped and provide medical assistance to the injured. The cause of the building collapse is not yet known, and investigations are expected to follow.

stories.headline: Ghaziabad Surya Pratap murder: Main accused Asad shot dead in encounter
stories.summary: The main accused in the Ghaziabad teen murder case, Asad, was shot dead in a police encounter on Sunday. Asad was wanted for the murder of 17-year-old Surya Pratap Chauhan, who was stabbed in the stomach on May 28. The incident sparked outrage and protests in Ghaziabad's Khoda Colony. According to police, Asad was killed in a late-night encounter. The murder case had drawn attention due to its alleged connection to a Bakrid invitation. Police officials confirmed that Asad was the main accused in the case and was killed in the encounter. The incident is being investigated further by the authorities. The encounter occurred after a complaint was filed at the Khoda police station regarding the stabbing of Surya Pratap Chauhan.

stories.headline: Assault on Abhishek Banerjee in Sonarpur raises questions, concerns about security
stories.summary: Abhishek Banerjee, a TMC leader and MP, was attacked during a visit to Sonarpur to meet families of post-poll violence victims. The incident occurred when a group of people confronted him, hurling stones, eggs, and abuses, and scuffling with him. The TMC has blamed the BJP for the attack, calling it "BJP-sponsored" and questioning the withdrawal of Banerjee's security. The incident has raised concerns about the security arrangements for top leaders, particularly in situations where they may be at risk. The attack has sparked a fresh political confrontation, with the TMC and BJP trading accusations. The incident is being seen as an example of the climate of violence in the region, with questions being raised about how protesters were able to breach security around a high-profile leader like Banerjee. An investigation into the incident is likely to follow.

stories.headline: India Blocks US-Run Parody Account Amid Free Speech Concerns
stories.summary: India has blocked a US-run parody account on Elon Musk's social media platform X, citing "legal demand" and "national security concerns" raised by the Intelligence Bureau. The account was withheld along with several other parody and activist accounts. Similarly, the Indian government has instructed Instagram to block a satirical news page called 'Savala Vada'. The move has triggered free speech concerns in the country. The Supreme Court has directed the Centre and states to curb hate speech on social media while emphasizing the importance of free expression. The ruling aims to strike a balance between regulating hate speech and protecting freedom of speech, and its implications are being closely watched. The blocks on parody accounts have added to the growing concerns about the state of free speech in India.

stories.headline: Western Media Boosts 'Cockroach Party' Meme to Challenge Indian Government
stories.summary: A satirical online project, the Cockroach Janta Party, has gone viral in India, tapping into youth frustration with the government. The parody party, which uses a cockroach as its symbol, was created in response to an insult directed at Gen Z as "parasites." Millions of young Indians are now using the party as an outlet to express their dissatisfaction with corruption, joblessness, and political dysfunction. The movement has gained significant traction on social media, with memes and short videos mocking the government's shortcomings. The phenomenon reflects the anger and disillusionment of India's youth with the current political landscape, dominated by Prime Minister Modi since 2014. The Cockroach Janta Party has become a symbol of protest, with tens of millions of people participating in the online movement.

stories.headline: Gen-Z Narratives Used to Influence Politics and Challenge Incumbent Governments
stories.summary: Gen Z movements, including fourth-wave feminism and climate protests, have been influential in shaping politics and challenging incumbent governments worldwide. These movements have toppled governments in Asia and Africa, and their impact is being felt globally. The rise of AI-generated personas on social media platforms has also contributed to the spread of information and influence among Gen Z. Experts like Scott Galloway warn that AI-powered platforms can shape what young people see, believe, and accept as real. Recent events, such as the election of Zohran Mamdani in New York City, have shown that Gen Z is becoming increasingly engaged in politics, particularly around issues like cost of living. Protests and unrest, like those seen in Nepal in September 2025, demonstrate the growing power and influence of Gen Z in shaping global politics. Their actions are driven by a sense of economic disadvantage and desire for change.

stories.headline: US-Run Social Media Accounts Spark Diplomatic Tensions with India
stories.summary: A viral video showing an Indian couple facing racist abuse in the US has sparked diplomatic tensions between the two countries. The incident, which occurred recently, has reignited conversations around racism against Indians in America. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump's social media posts have also drawn criticism from India, with the country condemning an article shared by Trump that referred to India as a "hellhole". The Indian government has expressed its displeasure over the post, stating that it is unacceptable. The incident and Trump's posts have strained relations between the two nations, with India seeking a more respectful and diplomatic approach from the US. The tensions come amid efforts by the US to strengthen ties with India, with Trump recently praising the country as a strategic necessity.

stories.headline: RBI MPC meeting to US-Iran war: Top five triggers that may dictate the Indian stock market this week
stories.summary: The Indian stock market extended its losing streak for a sixth straight week due to escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. The Sensex fell 1,092 points to 74,775.74, while the Nifty declined. However, on Friday, the Nifty 50 gained 0.32% to 23,719.30, and the Sensex rose 0.23% to 75,415.35. This week, key factors to watch include the RBI's monetary policy meeting, US-Iran tensions, interest rate decisions, and crude oil price fluctuations. The RBI's decision on interest rates and its record dividend payout will be closely monitored. Geopolitical conflicts and crude oil prices will also impact the market. These factors are expected to dictate the Indian stock market's performance this week, as investors remain cautious amid global uncertainties. The market's reaction to these triggers will be crucial in determining its trajectory.

stories.headline: Indian stock market: On Friday, Sensex was down 1,092 points, or 1.44%, at 74,775.74
stories.summary: The Indian stock market experienced a significant decline on Friday, with the Sensex dropping 1,092 points, or 1.44%, to 74,775.74. The Nifty 50 also ended weak, falling 359 points, or 1.50%. The decline was attributed to a late-minute selling rush, with the Sensex dropping as much as 1,278.69 points during the day. The market downturn was also influenced by reports of a below-normal monsoon season rainfall. The Nifty Bank settled lower, while the Sensex ended at 74,775.74, down 1,092.05 points, or 1.44%. The Nifty 50 closed below 22,400, with a decline of 1.50%. The Indian stock market crash on May 29, 2026, resulted in significant losses for investors.

stories.headline: The Nifty 50 also ended weak, falling 359 points, or 1.50%, to settle at 22,204.65
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 index fell 359 points, or 1.50%, to settle at 22,204.65. The 30-share Sensex also declined, crashing 1,313 points, or 1.70%, to end at 76,015.28. However, an earlier report stated the Nifty 50 closed at 23,815.85, down 1.50%. The Nifty 50 is a diversified 50-stock index representing key sectors of the economy, with a base period of November 3, 1995. The index's performance is closely tracked, with live price charts and market data available. The decline in both the Nifty 50 and Sensex indicates a weak market trend. The Nifty 50 index companies' performance and stock prices are closely monitored, with market data and analysis provided by financial platforms. The index's movement has a significant impact on the overall market sentiment and investor decisions.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty likely to remain volatile amid global cues, RBI MPC meet this week
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is expected to remain volatile due to global uncertainties and the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meet. The Sensex and Nifty may experience fluctuations, with short-term resistance at 25,400-25,500 levels and key support at 24,500-24,600. The RBI recently raised the benchmark lending rate by 50 basis points to 5.90% to curb inflation. Banking stocks are likely to be in focus after Bank Nifty's strong rally, climbing 1,238.30 points or 2.29% to close at 55,293.65. The GIFT Nifty was trading at 25,331.50, up 0.16% or 40.50 points, indicating a positive start for domestic markets. The market will be closely watching the RBI's policy decision and global cues for further direction.

stories.headline: Market Outlook: US-Iran talks, crude oil among 5 factors to drive D-St in first week of June Markets brace for a crucial week. Investors watch US-Iran peace talks closely. Crude oil price drops also impact sentiment. Foreign investors sold heavily, impa
stories.summary: US-Iran peace talks are being closely watched by investors, with progress in ceasefire discussions easing supply fears and contributing to a drop in crude oil prices. Oil prices fell by over 3% as traders unwound part of the recent risk premium. The development has impacted market sentiment, with foreign investors selling heavily and affecting Indian equities. Meanwhile, the Rupee has shown strength against the US Dollar. Technical indicators suggest a lack of strong trend, making markets sensitive to geopolitical and economic developments. The upcoming week is expected to be crucial, with investors monitoring the US-Iran talks and other factors, including crude oil prices, to drive market direction. The recent decline in oil prices has brought relief to markets, which are awaiting further progress in the peace talks.

stories.headline: Energy crunch fuels car pool growth Rising fuel prices triggered by the Middle East war are driving a sharp increase in carpooling, with a ride-sharing platform reporting a surge in new users seek
stories.summary: Rising fuel prices triggered by the Middle East war are driving a sharp increase in carpooling. A ride-sharing platform has reported a surge in new users seeking cheaper ways to travel. Global fuel prices have risen sharply since the conflict began, impacting transportation habits. In the UK, 59% of journeys are made by car or van, while 2% are by bike. The increase in fuel prices has also affected ride-hailing services, with some commuters relying on them more, while others are cutting back or switching between apps. Gasoline and diesel fuel prices continue to rise, with weekly updates on sales, revenue, and prices. The shift towards carpooling and changes in ride-hailing usage are a response to the rising fuel costs, as people seek more affordable transportation options. This trend is being observed in various cities, including Lagos.

stories.headline: Bonus issues, dividends and more: Reliance Industries, Trent among 20 stocks turning ex-date this week Reliance Industries, Trent, and 18 other stocks are set to turn ex-date this week for corporate actions including dividends and bonus issues. Investors must hol
stories.summary: Reliance Industries, Trent, and 18 other stocks will turn ex-date this week due to corporate actions such as dividends and bonus issues. Investors must hold shares by the record date to be eligible. Key events include Anand Rathi Wealth's 1:1 bonus issue and Trent's 1:2 bonus issue. Other prominent names like Cipla, Bank of Baroda, and HDFC Asset Management Company will trade ex-dividend. The week will also see a mix of income distributions and a major share buyback. These corporate actions can influence short-term trading sentiment and shareholder returns. Investors are advised to keep track of record dates and eligibility timelines to receive benefits from these actions. The ex-date is crucial as it determines which shareholders are eligible to receive dividends, bonuses, or other benefits.

stories.headline: Hong Kong property recovery tested as bigger student housing deals gain traction Hotel conversions draw institutional capital back to distressed assets as banks push disposals and financing conditions improve.
stories.summary: Hong Kong's student housing sector is seeing larger institutional-style deals emerge from the city's distressed commercial property market. Hotel conversions are drawing institutional capital back to these assets as banks push disposals and financing conditions improve. This trend is a test of the city's property recovery, which has been gaining momentum in recent months. Lower interest rates, an equity rebound, and returning mainland buyers have been lifting property prices, with some indicators suggesting the housing market may be at or near a bottom. The emergence of bigger student housing deals suggests that investors are regaining confidence in Hong Kong's property market, particularly in niche sectors such as student accommodation.
